name: 愤怒铁拳
description: 选择敌人（1），造成4次0.25倍伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,b=context.battle;var target=selectTarget({type:'piece',range:1,filter:'enemy'});if(!target||target.needsTargetSelection)return target;var t=b.pieces.find(function(p){return p.instanceId===target.instanceId&&p.currentHp>0;});if(!t)return{success:false,message:'目标不存在或不相邻'};var total=0,hits=0;for(var i=0;i<4;i++){if(t.currentHp<=0)break;var r=dealDamage(c,t,Math.floor(c.attack*.25),'physical',b,context.skill.id);total+=r.damage||0;hits++;}return{success:true,message:c.name+'连续挥拳'+hits+'次，造成'+total+'点伤害'};}
